music_directory.description: Path to the local music directory served by MPD.

mpd_host.description: The hostname or IP address of the MPD server.

mpd_port.description: The port number for the MPD server.

enable_mpdc.description: Whether to enable connection to the MPD server.

web_interface_host.description: The network interface address to bind the web server to.

web_interface_port.description: The port number for the web server interface.

max_browse_depth.description: Maximum depth for hierarchical browsing of artists and albums.

default_shuffle.description: Enable shuffle mode by default when playing albums.

default_repeat.description: Enable repeat mode by default when playing albums.

included_extensions.description: List of audio file extensions to include in the music library.

log_level.description: The logging level for plattenalbum operations.
